items.title: Generic Question Mark Cup Holder
description: This is a completely generic cubic cup holder with a question mark on it. It is sized to fit your generic insulated stainless steel tumbler, and can also hold most ceramic mugs. It has a slot on the side for the mug handle, as well as two counter sunk screw holes on the back in case you want to mount it somewhere. Maybe on a generic video game arcade machine.

items.title: The Mini Drum
items.subtitle: Compact Practice Pad
description: The Mini Drum is a compact, pre-designed electronic drum pad perfect for practice setups or portable kits. This ready-to-print STL file requires no customization—just download, slice, and print.

The design features a simplified construction that's quick to print and easy to assemble. It's ideal for beginners who want to get started with DIY electronic drums without the complexity of a full-sized build.
